title: Rescue in the Forbidden Grounds
next_chapter_hook: Just when Chen Ji thought everything had settled, the fragment in Su Qingyao's hand flickered with an eerie glow—its aura from the same source as the Tianji Record, yet carrying a distinctly different mark of destiny.

text.content: Scalding hot. The fragment in his Mental Sea seemed forged in raging flames, golden patterns spreading like living creatures deep within Chen Ji's soul, burning so fiercely that his brow center throbbed. This sensation was all too familiar—every time the Tianji Record manifested, it was always this bone-deep scalding. But this time was different. Previously, after awakening, the fragment would quiver faintly in the depths of his Mental Sea, providing blurry glimpses of the future. Yet now, the fragment not only burned hot but tore an opening in his Mental Sea, revealing another page hidden behind it—a blank page never before seen by the world, its edges carved with dense fate runes. Chen Ji's entire body shuddered as profound information directly poured into his mind: The Fourth Page, Fate Writer. Can rewrite small-scale fate nodes within three chi, usable once per day, cost is ten points of Heavenly Fate. Just as he hadn't yet digested this information, an urgent transmission exploded in his mind—it was Mo Xiansheng's voice, carrying unprecedented urgency.

dialogue.content: The Tianji Pavilion people came under suspicious circumstances—their true intention was not to retrieve the fragment, but to divert your attention. Su Qingyao is trapped in the core of the Tianji Ruins, where the place where the Tianji Record was first torn lies hidden!

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The Tianji Ruins—one of the most dangerous forbidden lands across the entire continent of Heavenly Secrets, where it was said no one who entered had ever emerged alive. His figure flashed as he rushed outside, his divine sense instantly locking onto Su Qingyao's location—the red dot on that Jade Slip was flickering violently, as if begging for rescue. The coordinates shown made Chen Ji freeze completely on the spot. East longitude thirty-seven degrees, north latitude nine degrees—this set of numbers was carved deepest in his memory, the only clue his mother left before disappearing. Fifteen years had passed; he had thought it was nothing but the ravings of a madwoman, never expecting it to reappear in such a way. The Tianji Ruins was precisely where his mother had vanished.

Two hot tears swirled in Chen Ji's eyes, but he forced them back by sheer will. He had been only seven when his mother disappeared, only remembering her stroking his head before leaving, saying, "Remember this coordinate, Ji'er." He had once thought those were merely a mother's final mutterings, once believed he would never have any connection to these numbers in this lifetime. Yet fate, after all its twists and turns, had pushed him here nonetheless. Chen Ji took a deep breath, the True Qi in his body surging like an angry dragon, transforming into a streak of light that raced toward the southeast at breakneck speed. He didn't know why Su Qingyao would appear there, nor what other secrets that place might harbor, but one thing he was absolutely certain of—that foolish woman, he had to rescue her.

choice.prompt: During the pursuit, Chen Ji discovered his position was completely exposed under Tianji Pavilion's surveillance, with the entrance to the Tianji Ruins just thirty li ahead. Mo Xiansheng warned him that Tianji Pavilion might have set an ambush.

choices.description: Regardless of Tianji Pavilion's surveillance, charge directly toward the ruins entrance at the fastest speed, using velocity to shake off potential pursuers
choices.visible_cost: Exposing one's position, potentially inviting encirclement attacks
choices.visible_reward: Arriving at the fastest speed, granting more time for rescue
choices.risk_hint: If encountering an ambush, one will face attacks from both front and back

text.content: Chen Ji let out a cold laugh, his True Qi pushed to its absolute limit, his entire body transforming into a streak of cyan light that shattered through the sky. Tianji Pavilion's surveillance? He wished they would see clearly—that today, Chen Ji was going to brazenly storm the forbidden grounds to rescue someone, and anyone who dared block his path would get their face stepped on. The moment the light streaked across the heavens, he even deliberately released a wisp of Tianji Record's aura—that was naked provocation.

choices.description: Suppress one's aura, use terrain as cover to quietly approach the ruins entrance, avoiding startling the enemy
choices.visible_cost: Consuming more time, Su Qingyao may fall into greater danger
choices.visible_reward: Maintaining concealment, enabling observation of the ambush situation around the ruins
choices.risk_hint: Time is critical, with each moment of delay Su Qingyao becomes more endangered

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed all his aura, executing the concealment technique of the Tianqing Sect, his entire person merging into the shadows of the mountains. He moved like a lurking venomous snake, silently approaching the ruins entrance. As expected, he detected at least three divine senses hidden in the Void—those were scouts from Tianji Pavilion. However, what truly caught Chen Ji's attention was the faint scent of blood lingering at the ruins entrance—someone had already gone in, and something had gone wrong.

choices.description: First create a disturbance at the periphery to draw attention, then infiltrate the ruins from another direction
choices.visible_cost: Requiring extra energy expenditure, and potentially being exposed
choices.visible_reward: Can draw ambushers away from the main entrance
choices.risk_hint: If the opponent sees through the strategy, all efforts will be in vain
choices.process_label: real and fake, lure into trap

text.content: A playful arc curled at the corner of Chen Ji's lips. He took out a puppet from his storage bag, infused it with True Qi, and commanded it to race in the opposite direction. That puppet carried a wisp of the Tianji Record's aura, enough to make those scouts paranoid. As expected, the three divine senses hidden in the shadows were instantly drawn away—two pursued, leaving only one still at its position. A cold smile formed in Chen Ji's heart—he could handle one, with absolute certainty.

The entrance to the Tianji Ruins was a pitch-black fissure, as if the heavens and earth had been slashed open by a blade. Gray mist swirled around the rift, and within that mist, golden runes moved like invisible chains.

The moment Chen Ji drew near, the mist surged like a living thing, countless runes coiling towards him from all directions.

"Fate Shackles..." Chen Ji murmured, a glint of solemnity flickering in his eyes. He had seen records of these runes in ancient texts—they were the concentrated source power of the Tianji Record, specifically targeting those with prophetic abilities. Once entangled, all fate-related powers within the body would be sealed.

In other words, once the Fate Shackles bound him, the Tianji Record would cease to function entirely.

Yet Chen Ji did not retreat.

He stepped into the fissure, allowing the golden runes to coil around his body. The moment the runes touched his skin, an excruciating pain shot from the depths of his marrow, as if countless fine needles were piercing him simultaneously. Golden patterns emerged on his skin—that was the Fate Shackles corroding the power of the Tianji Record within him.

But just as the shackles were about to lock completely, the fourth page at Chen Ji's brow suddenly burst into radiance—a blank page revealing an ancient rune, greedily absorbing the fate energy缠绕在他身上的命运之力。

"命运书写者，能改写命运节点——那这命运枷锁本身，是否也能算作一个节点？"

Chen Ji's mind sparked with inspiration.

He stopped resisting the shackles and instead guided them towards his fourth page. The golden runes poured into the blank page like rivers converging to the sea, leaving a faint mark upon it—the imprint of a rewritten fate node.

Simultaneously, the shackles entangling his body suddenly loosened, dissolving into scattered golden light in the void.

Chen Ji exhaled deeply, fine beads of sweat already forming on his forehead. The Heavenly Fate had cost him ten points, but compared to being sealed, this price was negligible. What delighted him more was that the fourth page's ability exceeded his imagination—not only could it rewrite fate nodes, but it could also absorb fate-based attacks originally targeting him.

This meant that as long as the fate-based techniques were not overly powerful, he now had a method to counter them.

Passing through the mist at the entrance, Chen Ji finally saw the interior of the Tianji Ruins.

It resembled a collapsed palace, with broken walls and debris emanating an ancient aura. The ground was carved with complex formation patterns, most already shattered, but a few still glowed faintly. What alarmed him most were the bloodstains on the ground—they were still fresh, clearly indicating a fierce battle had occurred here not long ago.

Following the blood trail, Chen Ji soon spotted a familiar figure beside a pile of rubble.

Su Qingyao knelt half on the ground, blood trickling from the corner of her mouth. A pale blue light barrier surrounded her, clearly the last defensive formation she had deployed. The barrier was already crumbling, riddled with cracks, on the verge of collapse.

"Su Qingyao!"

Chen Ji shouted, his form darting to her side like lightning. He pressed his palm against the light barrier,true qicrazed涌入。The sensation made his heart sink—Su Qingyao's true qi was nearly exhausted; this barrier was entirely sustained by her stubborn will.

Su Qingyao struggled to lift her head. Upon seeing Chen Ji, a flash of astonishment crossed her eyes, immediately replaced by anxiety.

"Why are you here? Run! There are... cough... there are ambushes here..."

Before she could finish, a cold, sinister laughter echoed from the depths of the ruins. Three figures then emerged from the shadows, each emanating an aura no weaker than late Foundation Building.

"The trash from Tianqing Sect actually dared to follow here." The leader licked his lips, eyes full of mockery, "Perfect. We'll take care of both of you together."

choice.prompt: Three late Foundation Building enemies had surrounded Chen Ji and Su Qingyao, and Su Qingyao was already incapable of fighting. Chen Ji had to make a choice: fight to the end or find another way out?

choices.description: Directly use the full power of the fourth page to rewrite the fate of this area, completely erasing the three enemies
choices.visible_cost: Consumes thirty points of Heavenly Fate, and may expose the full capabilities of the fourth page
choices.visible_reward: Instantly kill three enemies, deterring all those with covetous intentions
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Fate consumption is too great, and will cause those with ill intentions to notice the anomaly of the Tianji Record

text.content: A cold, grim smile curved Chen Ji's lips. He slowly raised his right hand, and the rune on the fourth page in his palm suddenly glowed. In the next instant, the space within ten zhang was as if twisted by some invisible force—the three enemies' faces froze mid-sneer. They felt their fates being forcibly rewritten."Want to kill her?" Chen Ji's voice was ice-cold as the abyss's spring, "Did you ask me?" Between the flashing runes, the three men's bodies began to visibly disintegrate, turning into scattered starlight dissolving into the void. Crushing—that was absolute crushing.

choices.description: Only use the first three pages of the Tianji Record for prediction and evasion, allowing Su Qingyao to recover somewhat before joining forces to face the enemy
choices.visible_cost: Combat time extends, and Su Qingyao's injuries may worsen
choices.visible_reward: Do not expose the fourth page's ability, maintain the strategy of playing dumb to devour the tiger
choices.risk_hint: If the enemies have hidden moves, may fall into a passive situation

text.content: Chen Ji did not动用第四页，而是将第一页的预判能力催动到极致。三名敌人的攻击轨迹在他眼中清晰可见，他侧身、闪避、格挡，每一次动作都恰到好处地避开致命一击，同时将敌人的攻势引向彼此。三人被这诡异的步法绕得晕头转向，配合逐渐出现破绽。Su Qingyao seized the moment, sitting cross-legged, desperately recovering her true qi, eyes flickering with complex emotions—this "trash" disciple's combat prowess far exceeded her imagination.

choices.description: Directly point out the three men's identity backgrounds and underlying forces, implying that both the Tianji Pavilion and Holy Sect are watching this place, using words to force back the enemy
choices.visible_cost: Expose that one controls large amounts of intelligence, possibly inviting more investigation
choices.visible_reward: Conquer the enemy without fighting, preserve strength
choices.risk_hint: If the other party doesn't fall for this, will completely enrage the enemy

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his gaze sweeping over the three men, a hint of ridicule playing at the corner of his mouth. "The son of an Xuanwu Sect Outer Disciple Executive, an intelligence dealer from Xuan Yin Pavilion, and... a castaway from the Holy Sect?" He pronounced each word deliberately, watching their expressions gradually stiffen, an inner cold smile forming. "Three gentlemen, do you think the Tianji Pavilion's envoy just left, and you动手对付我，如果我死在这里，天机阁会怎么想？三大宗门会不会因此掀起一场腥风血雨？"The three men exchanged glances, eyes flickering with hesitation.

Just as the atmosphere reached a standoff, Su Qingyao suddenly spoke.

"Chen Ji, don't... don't waste words with them." Her voice was weak but carried a stubborn edge, "They're not here for me... they're here for you... The people from Tianji Pavilion left a mark on me. As long as they kill you, this mark will transfer to you... they can track the aura of the Tianji Record..."

Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted.

So that was it—Su Qingyao being trapped here was no accident at all, but an elaborately set bait. The mark on her body would attract dangers from within the Tianji Ruins, while the people from Tianji Pavilion would lie in wait, waiting for him to walk into their trap.

What a brilliant two-birds-with-one-stone scheme.

"The leader burst into laughter upon hearing this, his voice filled with triumph.

"You littletrash, do you think we went through all this trouble for nothing? The Tianji Record fragments have been hidden in the Tianqing Sect for years, and we've long wanted to get our hands on them. Unfortunately, that old不死 kept guarding them tightly, and we never had a chance. Now..." He licked his lips, a greedy glint flashing in his eyes, "Since you've delivered yourself to us, don't blame us for being ruthless."

As his words fell, all three attacked simultaneously.

Chen Ji's expression slightly changed. He pulled Su Qingyao close with one arm and retreated rapidly. But the three's attacks were too fast and fierce—he couldn't dodge in time, only able to watch helplessly as three ruthless strikes came hurling toward him.

At this critical moment, the symbols on the fourth page lit up once again."

Chen Ji instinctively activated the fourth page's power.

This time, he didn't attempt to rewrite the enemies' fate, but instead rewrote his own position. The symbols on the blank page flickered violently. The space within a three-foot radius seemed to be gently nudged by an invisible hand, and Chen Ji and Su Qingyao's forms vanished on the spot, reappearing ten zhang away in the next instant.

The three attacks missed, blasting three massive craters into the ground.

"This... what kind of demonic technique is this?!" The leader's face turned pale, his eyes filled with disbelief.

A faint smile curved the corner of Chen Ji's mouth, but his heart was bleeding—he had just lost another 10 Heavenly Fate points. Yet at this moment, he couldn't afford to feel the pain, because the fourth page's ability gave him a new idea: rewriting one's own fate nodes could not only be used for attack, but also for escape.

However, he couldn't keep consuming like this.

Chen Ji set Su Qingyao down, letting her lean against a broken wall. His gaze swept over the three men again, this time carrying a chilling killing intent.

"Since the three of you are so eager to witness the power of the Tianji Record, then Chen will show you as you wish."

He raised his hand, and the symbols on the fourth page burst into bloom. In that moment, an indescribable pressure emanated from him, as if some ancient existence was awakening. All three enemies' faces changed simultaneously—they felt their fates being gripped by an invisible giant hand, ready to be shattered at any moment.

"Run!"

The leader bellowed and turned to flee. Yet their speed was like a snail compared to Chen Ji. As the symbols flickered, the three men's forms suddenly froze—their fate nodes had been rewritten. At this moment, they would be unable to move.

Chen Ji didn't kill them.

Not because of softness, but because he needed survivors. There was clearly a larger force behind these three, and he needed to pry more information from them.

"Senior Sister Su, that mark on your body, let me remove it for you."

Su Qingyao stared at him blankly, her eyes shimmering with complex emotions. From the first time she suspected Chen Ji, more than half a year had passed. Throughout this half year, she had countless times wanted to uncover the true face of this "trash Junior Brother," yet every time he cleverly resolved the situation.

And now, she stood at the threshold of truth, only to find she no longer wanted to enter.

"Chen Ji... who exactly are you?"

Chen Ji didn't answer. He simply placed his hand over her lower abdomen, sending a thread of True Qi to search for that detestable mark.

The moment his fingertip touched the mark, Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly.

The mark was far more complex than he had imagined—it wasn't an ordinary tracking technique, but a brand using fate power as a medium. Ordinary methods couldn't erase it, unless...

Chen Ji's thought moved, and the symbols on the fourth page lit up once again.

He would use fate to rewrite fate.

As the symbols flickered, the mark began to struggle violently, as if sensing danger. Yet the fourth page's power was so domineering that within several breaths, the mark dissolved into scattered starlight, dissipating into the Void.

Su Qingyao groaned, her face growing pale, but that feeling of being watched had completely disappeared.

"Done." Chen Ji withdrew his hand, his expression calm.

Just then, an object slipped from Su Qingyao's hand.

It was a page of yellowed paper, its edges torn and worn, yet emanating an aura identical to the Tianji Record fragments. Chen Ji's pupils constricted. He bent down to pick up the page, and the moment it touched his hand, a familiar warm current surged from his fingertips into his Mental Sea—that was the call of the Tianji Record.

"This is..." His voice trembled slightly.

Su Qingyao spoke weakly: "I found it deep in the ruins... There are words on it, but I couldn't understand them..."

Chen Ji lowered his head to look at the fragment. Four ancient symbols were clearly written on it—those were the original characters of the Tianji Record, translating to just eight words:

"Heavenly Mandate Bestowed, Causation Reborn."

His entire body felt struck by thunder. He had seen these eight words before, word for word, in the old book his mother left him.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao watched Chen Ji's drastically changing expression and forced herself to ask: \"This page... is there something wrong with it? Do you recognize the characters?\"

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath and absorbed the fragment into his Mental Sea. The moment the fragment recognized its original pages, an intense tremor erupted within his Mental Sea, and new information appeared on the fourth page—records about the origin of the Tianji Record, fragmentary but enough for him to glimpse the tip of the iceberg.

The Tianji Record was not created by human hands, but rather a shard of Heavenly Dao's will. It was torn into nine pages scattered across the mortal world, each page bearing a portion of fate's authority. Those who gather all nine pages would possess the power to rewrite the Heavenly Dao and reshape reincarnation.

And now, he had two pages in hand.

Chen Ji raised his head to look at Su Qingyao, his gaze deep and unfathomable. Did this foolish woman have any idea that the thing she unknowingly picked up was enough to drive the entire cultivation world insane?

"Senior Sister Su," his voice low, "the importance of this page far exceeds your imagination. Before I investigate thoroughly, I hope you can keep it secret for me—toward anyone."

Outside the ruins, the messenger from the Tianji Pavilion floated in the high sky, watching everything. On the compass in his hand, the light representing Chen Ji was gradually approaching the ruins' exit.

"Interesting..." A meaningful smile curved the messenger's lips, "As the Heavenly Secrets indicated, he would use the fourth page's power in the moment of despair. Another experimental piece for the fate shackles, it seems."

He put away the compass and vanished into the horizon like a shooting star.

And deep within the distant Tianji Pavilion, in a pitch-black hall, some existence that had slumbered for ten thousand years slowly opened its eyes. Its pupils reflected the outline of the entire Heavenly Secrets Continent, and a playful smile appeared at the corner of its lips.

"The chess piece has moved... Good, very good."

That voice echoed through the empty hall, carrying an indescribable eeriness and strangeness.

Chen Ji helped Su Qingyao slowly walk out of the Tianji Ruins. Outside, the sky had begun to lighten. An entire night of fierce battle had left his spirit somewhat weary, yet an unprecedented excitement surged in his heart.

The coordinates his mother left, the origin of the Tianji Record, the fourth page's power—all the clues pointed in the same direction. That mystery that had haunted him for fifteen years seemed finally about to be revealed.

"Chen Ji," Su Qingyao suddenly spoke, her voice very soft, "thank you for saving me."

Chen Ji turned to look at her. Under the moonlight, her face was pale yet beautiful, her eyes' expression complex and unfathomable.

"No need for thanks, Senior Sister Su," he smiled faintly, "Fellow disciples helping each other is only proper."

Su Qingyao opened her mouth as if to say something, but ultimately it turned into a sigh. She knew that from this moment on, there would be no turning back between her and Chen Ji.

Whether ahead lay an abyss or a road to the heavens, she had already chosen to stand on his side.

dialogue.content: Just as the two fell into silence, the communication Jade Slip in Chen Ji's embrace suddenly vibrated. His brow furrowed slightly. He took it out to look, and his face abruptly changed—the message was from the Tianqing Sect's old Sect Master Ling Yuan: \"Return to the sect immediately. There is important business to discuss.\" The characters on the Jade Slip were cold and majestic, brook ing no refusal.

text.content:
Chen Ji put the Jade Slip back into his embrace, his gaze flickering uncertainly.

Was Ling Yuan summoning him back at this time a coincidence or a premeditated plan? The Tianji Pavilion's messenger had just left, and the old Sect Master was急着 summoning him—if there was nothing suspicious about this, he'd打死not believe it.

But he couldn't refuse to go.

At least not yet. The old Sect Master's power within the Tianqing Sect ran deep and wide. If he openly defied orders, it would only alert the enemy and make the situation more passive.

"Senior Sister Su," he turned to look at Su Qingyao, "Return to the sect first to recover from your injuries. I have matters to attend to."

Su Qingyao looked at him, wanting to speak but holding back. She knew Chen Ji had many secrets, but she also knew this wasn't the time to press for answers.

"Be careful," she said softly.

A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips. He turned and walked toward the opposite direction. Ling Yuan wanted to see him? Fine, he'd see him—just let him find out what this scheming old Sect Master was really up to.
